# Filter rows where Year is before 1980
# Since Year is a string like "1977–1978", we need to extract the start year
# Convert start year to integer for comparison
df['Start_Year'] = df['Year'].str.split('–').str[0].astype(int)
pre_1980 = df[df['Start_Year'] < 1980]
# Get unique shirt sponsors from those rows
unique_sponsors = pre_1980['Shirt Sponsor'].dropna().unique()
# Convert to list and sort for consistent output (if needed)
answer = sorted(unique_sponsors.tolist())
